messages:
maria (People Ops): Hey folks — dropping a new lightweight template we piloted for connecting goals to concrete evidence: the 'Goal Evidence Matrix'. Link: https://go.redwood/gem (view-only). Please try it for this cycle and share feedback.
kevin (Eng): Nice. Quick question — is this meant to replace the OKR key results or sit alongside them?
sophie (Product): my read: KR stays, matrix is the evidence log that backs each KR. helps for reviews and promotion packets.
maria (People Ops): Correct — matrix = structured evidence (+signals) you collect through the quarter. KRs = outcomes. We want managers/ICs to add 1–3 discrete evidence items per KR.
jamal (Manager): Can we see an example for a cross-functional KR? sometimes evidence is from other teams.
maria (People Ops): Yup — example included in doc under "examples". Short sample:
```
KR: Reduce inference p95 for hosted API by 25%
Evidence 1: Deploy A/B with batching -> p95 down 350ms -> 230ms (prod metrics, 2026-02-18)
Evidence 2: Circuit breaker rollout prevented 3 incidents (incident IDs: INC-4123, INC-4172)
Owner: eng-runtime@redwood
Reviewer notes: shows measurable perf & reliability wins
```
kevin (Eng): love that. Can we also add a field for how the team measured signal quality (e.g., synthetic vs. user telemetry)?
maria (People Ops): Good call — added "signal source" column.
sophie (Product): For product-facing KRs, add "customer impact" line (qualitative + metric). Helps PMs narrate impact.
jamal (Manager): For managers: any recommended phrasing to give constructive feedback on evidence quality? want to standardize comments across teams.
maria (People Ops): Suggested manager micro-phrases in the doc under "Manager Guidance" — short, actionable templates like: 
- "Good: measurable, date-stamped, links to dashboards. Please add a short note on methodology."
- "Needs improvement: outcome is clear but evidence is anecdotal. Can you add a log/dashboard snippet or test results?"
- "Stretch guidance: this evidence supports promotion considerations — quantify contributor scope."
kevin (Eng): timeline question — do we update continuously or only at mid/ end-cycle?
hr-bot: Reminder: Mid-cycle check-ins open next Monday (2026-03-30). People Ops recommends ongoing updates but we'll snapshot on the check-in date.
sophie (Product): ongoing updates is best. small weekly notes save time at review.
jamal (Manager): I'll ask my direct reports to add at least one evidence row per KR by EOD next Wed.
maria (People Ops): Awesome — thanks. If any teams want a shorter 3-row "quick GEM" we made that too in the doc (one-pager). Ping me if you want a walkthrough — I can join a 15-min team sync. :thumbsup:
